# InlineQueryHandler

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.handlers.InlineQueryHandler`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(callback: Callable, filters = None): ...
```

## Documentation

The InlineQuery handler class. Used to handle inline queries.
It is intended to be used with [`add_handler`](../methods/utilities/add_handler.md)

For a nicer way to register this handler, have a look at the
[`on_inline_query`](../decorators/on_inline_query.md) decorator.

### Parameters

- **`callback`** (`Callable`)
  Pass a function that will be called when a new InlineQuery arrives. It takes *(client, inline_query)*
  as positional arguments (look at the section below for a detailed description).

- **`filters`** (`Filters`)
  Pass one or more filters to allow only a subset of inline queries to be passed
  in your callback function.

Other parameters:
    client (`Client`):
        The Client itself, useful when you want to call other API methods inside the inline query handler.

    inline_query ([`InlineQuery`](../types/inline_mode/InlineQuery.md)):
        The received inline query.

_Source: `pyrogram/handlers/inline_query_handler.py`._
